newsitem.title: USA: TU Comanche Peak 2 nuke back to full output.
newsitem.headline: TU Comanche Peak 2 nuke back to full output.

text.p: Texas Utilities Co said Friday its 1,150 megawatt (MW) Comanche Peak 2 nuclear power unit returned to full output following repairs to a heater drain pump and one of its feedwater pumps.
"It's at 100 percent power. They began ramping it up last night," said company spokeswoman Pat Nichols.
Comanche Peak 2 was operating at 55 percent of capacity while crews were repairing those pumps.
A heater drain pump helps collect condensed steam and a feedwater pump circulates water for steam production.
The neighboring Comanche Peak 1, also at 1,150 MW, was also running at full power. The unit is scheduled to shut for a 42-day refueling program in October.
The Comanche Peak units, in Glen Rose, Tx., produce about 18 percent of the company's electricity deliveries.
Texas Utilities is the operator and sole owner of the Comanche Peak facility.
